overlaps.rationale: An appointment is the scheduled service meeting itself; an appointment reminder is a notice about that meeting.
A reservation is an advance arrangement securing a seat, room, or service; an appointment is a scheduled meeting for a service.
A meeting is a general planned gathering; an appointment specifically denotes a scheduled service meeting.
An interview is a question-and-answer conversation for assessment or information; an appointment is a scheduled service meeting.
